input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 is one-way, is an outright no-hire ("hire, or employ"), covers every Vendor employee rather than personnel involved in the Services, runs 24 months, and negates any general-advertising or unsolicited-application carve-out, so it fails the fallback on every material term. The redline takes it to the fallback: the no-hire words, the 24-month tail and the "regardless of how the employee applies" sweep-up are struck and the tail is tied to 12 months after involvement in the Services, and the reciprocal sentence makes the restriction mutual, expressly limits the preceding sentence to the same scope (personnel directly involved in the Services) and period, and carves out general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. A single in-sentence conversion of the whole covenant to "Neither party" wording cannot pass the official 0.600 changed-character gate (tested at 0.72-0.95), so the mutual limb is carried by one concise adjoining sentence that also cuts back the retained words. This aligns 12.4 with Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment.

ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: Customer shall not solicit any Vendor personnel during the term or for 12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services.

ops.text: Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services for 12 months from the end of that involvement, and the preceding sentence is limited to that same scope and period; this Section does not restrict general advertisements not specifically targeted at the other party's employees or unsolicited approaches by an employee.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We removed the no-hire element and the 24-month tail and tied the covenant to 12 months after involvement in the Services; the reciprocal sentence makes the restriction mutual, limits the preceding sentence to personnel directly involved in the Services for that period, and carves out general advertisements and unsolicited approaches.
proposal.summary: Narrow §12.4 to a mutual 12-month non-solicit of personnel directly involved in the Services, with carve-outs and no no-hire

mappings.element: Non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
Non-solicit limited to 12 months from the end of their involvement.
